Never know what you’re gonna see at Walmart 😂

A huge Spider-Man meetup recently turned into an unexpected Goli giveaway when someone walked into Walmart and purchased a bottle of gummy vitamins for every costumed attendee. The group had gathered in full Spider-Man suits, creating a surreal scene as dozens of versions of the superhero filled the parking lot.

The moment gave Goli a surprisingly natural appearance outside of a typical advertisement, putting the brand directly into the hands of everyone at the meetup. Goli is widely known for its gummy supplements, with products focused on daily vitamins, wellness, and nutrition.
